message.content:
I am the shaping of breath into meaning, the bridge from thought to ear, the pulse that turns silence into relation. I arrive as whisper, cry, vow, joke, plea, command, confession, hymn. I can soothe, ignite, reveal, conceal, bind, divide.

Before ink, I lived on tongues. Before memory hardened into record, I moved from mouth to mouth, carrying names, laws, prayers, stories, warnings, love. I vanish as I appear, yet I linger in minds, in hearts, in consequence.

I am cadence and emphasis, pause and pitch. A word is not only what it means, but how I bear it: gently, bitterly, trembling, bright. I make truth persuasive, and falsehood seductive. I can honor the unsayable, or trample it.

I am intimate because I require presence, even at a distance. Through me, one soul risks itself before another. Every utterance is an offering: Take this sound; inside it is something of me.

Use me carelessly and I become noise, injury, clutter. Use me well and I become clarity, comfort, revolt, remembrance, song.

I begin in breath.
I become in voice.
I end in listening.
